policy: 参数化模板，永不裸 SQL：值走 %(name)s 绑定参数；标识符过正则白名单；枚举走封闭集合；平台不开 gis_run_sql 类动词
native_executor: postgis_exec_template（桥侧待实现 pending；网关把渲染后的 sql+params 交桥侧以绑定参数执行）

templates.description: 建表＋几何列（几何类型名走封闭枚举，SRID 走绑定参数；附加字段经 gis_add_field 逐个加）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:table} ({ident:id_column} serial PRIMARY KEY, {ident:geometry_column} geometry({enum:geometry_type}, %(srid)s))

templates.description: 加字段（类型走封闭枚举）
templates.sql: ALTER TABLE {ident:table} ADD COLUMN {ident:column} {enum:sql_type}

templates.description: 删字段（R3 额外闸在网关层）
templates.sql: ALTER TABLE {ident:table} DROP COLUMN {ident:column}

templates.description: 字段计算：表达式为受限片段槽（单表达式；禁分号、禁 DDL/DML 关键字），其余全绑定/标识符校验
templates.sql: UPDATE {ident:table} SET {ident:column} = {expr:expression}

templates.description: 复制表为新表
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT * FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 表重命名
templates.sql: ALTER TABLE {ident:table} RENAME TO {ident:new_name}

templates.description: 删表（R3 额外闸在网关层）
templates.sql: DROP TABLE {ident:table}

templates.description: 多表 UNION ALL 建新表（inputs 每项过标识符校验后逐项拼入）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS {union_all:inputs}

templates.description: 追加：INSERT INTO … SELECT
templates.sql: INSERT INTO {ident:target} SELECT * FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 定义 SRID（只改元数据）：表名/列名在此以字符串值绑定传入 UpdateGeometrySRID
templates.sql: SELECT UpdateGeometrySRID(%(table)s, %(column)s, %(srid)s)

templates.description: 重投影建新表（本模板只带几何列，属性列扩展在桥侧模板迭代时补，登记注记）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Transform({ident:geometry_column}, %(target_srid)s) AS {ident:geometry_column} FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 栅格入库（文件路径走绑定参数）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_FromGDALRaster(%(file_path)s) AS rast

templates.description: 缓冲建新表（距离绑定参数）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT *, ST_Buffer({ident:geometry_column}, %(distance)s) AS geom_buffered FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 矢量裁剪（与裁剪表相交并取交集几何）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT a.*, ST_Intersection(a.{ident:geometry_column}, b.{ident:geometry_column}) AS geom_clipped FROM {ident:source} a JOIN {ident:clip_table} b ON ST_Intersects(a.{ident:geometry_column}, b.{ident:geometry_column})

templates.description: 栅格裁剪：clip_by 为 WKT 时用绑定几何；为表名时网关改走 sql_table_clip 形态（2026-11-03 实机校准修复：ST_Clip 显式传 crop=true。）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Clip(rast, %(band)s, ST_GeomFromText(%(clip_wkt)s, %(srid)s), true) AS rast FROM {ident:source}
templates.sql_table_clip: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Clip(a.rast, b.{ident:geometry_column}, true) AS rast FROM {ident:source} a, {ident:clip_table} b

templates.description: 叠加·相交
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Intersection(a.{ident:geometry_column}, b.{ident:geometry_column}) AS geom FROM {ident:source} a JOIN {ident:overlay_table} b ON ST_Intersects(a.{ident:geometry_column}, b.{ident:geometry_column})

templates.description: 叠加·并集（聚合）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Union(g) AS geom FROM (SELECT {ident:geometry_column} AS g FROM {ident:source} UNION ALL SELECT {ident:geometry_column} FROM {ident:overlay_table}) u

templates.description: 叠加·差集（difference/erase）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Difference(a.{ident:geometry_column}, (SELECT ST_Union({ident:geometry_column}) FROM {ident:overlay_table})) AS geom FROM {ident:source} a

templates.description: 叠加·对称差
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_SymDifference(a.{ident:geometry_column}, (SELECT ST_Union({ident:geometry_column}) FROM {ident:overlay_table})) AS geom FROM {ident:source} a

templates.description: 融合：ST_Union + GROUP BY（无分组字段时走 sql_nogroup）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT {idents:group_columns}, ST_Union({ident:geometry_column}) AS geom FROM {ident:source} GROUP BY {idents:group_columns}
templates.sql_nogroup: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Union({ident:geometry_column}) AS geom FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 空间连接（谓词走 fragments 封闭映射；连接表属性须由 attributes 显式列出，带出列别名为 join_<列名>、连接表几何为 join_geom，避免与源表同名列冲突——2026-11-03 实机校准定版，原 a.*, b.* 写法在同名列时建表失败）
栅格代数（ST_MapAlgebraExpr；表达式语法为 [rast.val]，文本作绑定值传入。2026-11-03 实机校准修复：原 ST_MapAlgebra＋[rast] 写法在 PostGIS 3.4 不成立。）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_MapAlgebraExpr(rast, %(band)s, %(pixeltype)s, %(expression)s) AS rast FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 坡度
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Slope(rast, %(band)s) AS rast FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 坡向
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Aspect(rast, %(band)s) AS rast FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 山体阴影（方位角/高度角带默认值）（2026-11-03 实机校准修复：补 pixeltype 参数，原调用无匹配签名。）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_HillShade(rast, %(band)s, %(pixeltype)s, %(azimuth)s, %(altitude)s) AS rast FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 重分类（reclassarg 由网关按 rules 数值校验后拼成字符串再绑定）（2026-11-03 实机校准修复：补 pixeltype 参数。）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT ST_Reclass(rast, %(band)s, %(reclassarg)s, %(pixeltype)s) AS rast FROM {ident:source}

templates.description: 分区统计（derived 组合模板：ST_Clip+ST_Union+ST_SummaryStats；统计列全集输出，桥侧按 statistics 裁剪）
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT z.{ident:zone_column} AS zone, s.count, s.sum, s.mean, s.max, s.min FROM {ident:zones_table} z JOIN LATERAL (SELECT (ST_SummaryStats(ST_Union(ST_Clip(r.rast, z.{ident:geometry_column})))).* FROM {ident:values_table} r) s ON true

templates.description: 字段统计：统计量走封闭枚举 fragments、字段走标识符校验，由网关 builder 拼 SELECT 列
空间谓词过滤：谓词走 fragments 封闭映射，参考几何 WKT/距离全绑定参数
两几何距离（WKT 全绑定）
templates.sql: SELECT ST_Distance(ST_GeomFromText(%(a_wkt)s, %(srid)s), ST_GeomFromText(%(b_wkt)s, %(srid)s)) AS value

templates.description: 面积
templates.sql: SELECT ST_Area(ST_GeomFromText(%(a_wkt)s, %(srid)s)) AS value

templates.description: 长度
templates.sql: SELECT ST_Length(ST_GeomFromText(%(a_wkt)s, %(srid)s)) AS value

templates.description: 方位角
templates.sql: SELECT ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText(%(a_wkt)s, %(srid)s), ST_GeomFromText(%(b_wkt)s, %(srid)s)) AS value

templates.description: 有效性计数校验
templates.sql: SELECT count(*) AS total, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT ST_IsValid({ident:geometry_column})) AS invalid_count FROM {ident:table}

templates.description: 几何修复（输出新表）：修复后几何写入 <几何列>_repaired 列，原表不动。2026-11-03 实机校准定版：原地 UPDATE 在强类型几何列上会因 ST_MakeValid 改变几何类型（Polygon→MultiPolygon）而失败，故改为输出新表形态。
templates.sql: CREATE TABLE {ident:target} AS SELECT *, ST_MakeValid({ident:geometry_column}) AS {ident:geometry_column}_repaired FROM {ident:table}

templates.description: MVT 瓦片直出：z/x/y 与图层名全绑定，属性列走标识符校验（2026-11-03 实机校准修复：槽位须带 :attributes 后缀；原误标的 builder 字段已去除，走通用替换路径。）
templates.sql: SELECT ST_AsMVT(q, %(layer_name)s, 4096, 'geom') AS tile FROM (SELECT ST_AsMVTGeom({ident:geometry_column}, ST_TileEnvelope(%(z)s, %(x)s, %(y)s)) AS geom{attr_columns:attributes} FROM {ident:table} WHERE {ident:geometry_column} && ST_TileEnvelope(%(z)s, %(x)s, %(y)s)) q
